description: Dataset for Influence of climate change on the residential cooling demand in low-voltage distribution networks is a data set deposited in tuw.tudata by its authors Jakob Buchmeier, Claudia Benesch (TU Wien). This dataset provides simulation results investigating the combined impacts of climate change and air conditioning (AC) adoption on low-voltage distribution grids in the diploma thesis: Buchmeier, J. (2025). Impact of Climate Scenarios and Air Conditioning Penetration on Low-Voltage Grid Stability. Diploma Thesis, TU Wien. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
